description.text: In hand-inked 1990s cel-animation linework, a wide road-level view opens on a snow-covered city street at pale winter dawn.

, a black sports car with a carbon fibre body, rolls into the lane from the left, its glossy panels catching cold blue light while snowflakes drift across the frame. The street is quiet and deep with packed snow, low drifts along the kerb, dark buildings and bare trees softened by falling snow. The car is already in motion, nose angled slightly toward the viewer as its tyres press fresh tracks into the slush. Snow gathers on the windscreen and along the roofline; the carbon fibre weave reads as a subtle dark pattern under the pale sky. A thin plume of exhaust curls behind the car, and the whole street holds the flat, painted light of a winter morning.

The car leans into its forward motion as the street streams past: snow-covered parked vehicles, a low wall, and dark shopfronts reduced to soft cel-painted shapes. Snowflakes streak diagonally through the foreground, and the engine note rises while the tyres scour the road. The car remains the clear, continuous subject, with no return to a stationary display stance. Cold shadows pool under the drifts, and the pale sky presses flat against the rooftops.

Its carbon fibre rear haunches and roofline are clearly readable, edged with cold light and dusted snow, while the tyres roll through the packed surface and leave two dark tracks behind. Snowfall thickens, softening the buildings into flat cel-animation shapes and dimming the street into blue-grey distance. The car grows smaller but stays centered in the frame as it moves deeper into the storm, engine sound easing with distance. The final image holds the sense of travel and winter weather, with the car still in motion rather than settled into a static display pose.

claims.text: Keep the observed black sports car identity and carbon fibre body; redraw the scene as 1990s cel animation; let the car move through a snowy street; do not copy the source showroom background or static pose.
The snowy street is a quiet city lane at pale winter dawn, with packed snow, low drifts, dark buildings, bare trees, and falling snow.
The car presses fresh tracks, gathers snow on its windscreen and roofline, and throws slush and fine powder from its tyres as it drives.
Newly generated winter ambience includes wind over snow, tyres compressing and spraying slush, and an engine note that rises and fades with distance.
